rules.k6: rule K6: a run keeps one RUN_ID, one bundle, one queue, one budget and one commit for its whole life.  A session is refused when its REPO_REF is not the 40 hex digits of the checkout's commit (a smoke may name a branch or a tag); when its RUN_ID has a run directory with QUEUE.json and RESUME is not set; when RESUME is set and there is no such run, or the run is a smoke; when RESUME comes with another queue, set, bundle or budget (or other trainer options) than QUEUE.json holds; when the checkout's commit is not QUEUE.json's, unless allow_source_change is given (LEAD.json, LEAD_RULE; recorded and noted).  On a resume REPO_REF is QUEUE.json's
rules.k7: rule K7: a session with RESUME is refused while LIVE.json is younger than 600 s and was not closed by the session that wrote it, unless TAKEOVER is set (recorded); a run that has DONE.json, or a HALT.json that is not marked resumable, is finished and is not resumed; a resumable HALT.json is resumed only with the lead's remedy (RESUMABLE_RULE)
rules.lead: the lead's remedies (ruling 2 of 17 Nov 2026): one small file the lead writes on Drive beside the run, runs/<run_id>/LEAD.json, which session reads and records in the session's record (lead, and the values in force): retry_check, allow_source_change and allow_version_change (true or false; passed to the trainer as --retry-check on a resume, --allow-source-change, --allow-version-change; retry_check only in the session that resumes the halt whose remedy names it, never at a later resume: the lead's ruling 12 of 17 Nov 2026), budget_by and budget_set_on (rule Y10: written to QUEUE.json when the run is made; budget_set_on a UTC time such as 2026-11-20T09:00:00Z), and resume_halt (the halt_id of the resumable halt a resume answers), with an optional note.  The owner is never asked to set these.  A file that cannot be read, a key it does not name here or a value of the wrong type refuses the session; nothing is changed
rules.resumable: what is final and what is resumable (the lead's ruling 2 of 17 Nov 2026): the trainer's exit code 4 (a refusal) writes no HALT.json: the session ends and LIVE.json is closed, as for an interruption.  The trainer's exit code 5 (a halt for the lead) and any error of the launcher itself write a HALT.json marked resumable, with its halt_id and the remedy it names: retry_check when the trainer's halt names --retry-check, allow_source_change when it names --allow-source-change, and in every case the lead's word (LEAD.json's resume_halt names the halt).  session accepts a resume of such a run only with that remedy in LEAD.json, and then keeps the old halt as HALT_<k>.json (k: the session that halted).  Only a job that crashed twice halts the run for good (resumable false)
